english_source_note: Kronecker's Theorem, Dirichlet's Theorem, and Applications
statement_en: If $\frac{\beta}{\alpha} \not \in \mathbb{Q}$, then the set $\alpha \mathbb{Z}+\beta \mathbb{Z}$ is dense in the real numbers (with the Euclidean topology).
callout_body: 若实数$\frac{\beta}{\alpha} \not \in \mathbb{Q}$，那么集合$\alpha \mathbb{Z}+\beta \mathbb{Z}$在实数中稠密（欧氏拓扑）。
